name: Snap
description: Snap/: SnapLine, SnapGap, SnapGuides (the lines and gaps a drag shows, their summary, the empty and fake guides), SnapCandidate, Snapping (the offset order lines, then gaps, then whole points; candidates over the layer tree arrive with EK-18), and SnapLines and SnapGaps, the alignment and spacing engines whose stubs the snapping feature's SN-2 and SN-3 fill.
technology: Swift 6, Foundation (FoundationEssentials) and FlareCore, Linux and macOS
